prompt: Read two integers separated by whitespace on stdin and print their sum followed by a newline.
Read one non-negative integer n from stdin and print n! followed by a newline.
Read all of stdin and print the number of whitespace-separated words followed by a newline.

Read one line from stdin and print the line reversed, without the trailing newline, followed by a newline.
